property_summary: For every caller and payment value, calling Put(...) on the correct contract always triggers an external Log.AddMessage call (so the deployed Log receives a record and increments its History), whereas the mutant removes that call so there exist inputs where Put finishes but the Log records nothing; the test asserts that after Put the Log's History length increased (reference: always true; mutant: false for some inputs).
change_summary: Remove the LogFile.AddMessage call from Put so that Put does not make the external call to Log, which can cause Put to no longer revert when logging would revert.
